title: Implement AisleConfig Parsing
description: Implement `AisleConfigParser.parse(_:)` for bracketed sections, `|`-delimited aliases, comment skipping, blank-line skipping, and silent dropping of items outside sections.
acceptance_criteria: `AisleConfigParser.parse(_:)` returns an empty config for empty or comment-only input.
Section headers are parsed from `[name]` lines with trimmed names preserved verbatim.
Item lines split on `|` only, trim each token, preserve internal whitespace, and map first token to canonical plus remainder to aliases.
Items outside sections are skipped without inventing a bucket.

handoff_summary.completed: Added `Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/AisleConfigParser.swift` with section-aware parsing that trims section names, splits item aliases only on `|`, trims each token, preserves internal whitespace, skips blank and comment-only lines, and ignores items before any section. Verified the new file type-checks with `xcrun swiftc -typecheck` against `AisleConfig.swift`.
handoff_summary.risks: No test suite was run per guardrails. Validation in this pass was limited to Swift type-checking of the parser and model files.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Low. Work was confined to a new source file in the assigned scope within a shared worktree.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Implemented comment skipping as lines whose trimmed content starts with `--`, matching the bead scope. Section headers are recognized from trimmed `[name]` lines, with the inner name whitespace-trimmed and stored verbatim. Item parsing keeps internal token whitespace intact by splitting only on `|` and trimming token edges.
